<a id="read_keys"></a>
### [`read_keys`](../../../../src/input/keyboard.asm#L6) `$5D2B`

*routine*

On alternate frames reads F1/F3/F5/F7 into $4086 (1-4, 0 none) or SPACE into $4090.
